title: Software Engineer
teaser: We are expanding our team: As a Full-Stack Wireless Software Engineer, you will develop and validate wireless features across access points, controllers, and management systems. This role involves full software development and testing, ideal for candidates with strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python, and a solid understanding of networking fundamentals.
description:
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet The Team

The Cisco Wireless Feature & System Engineering team builds end-to-end wireless capabilities across access points, controllers, and cloud-managed platforms. We design features that span device software, control planes, and management systems to deliver seamless, secure, and high-performance enterprise Wi-Fi.

Your Impact

As a Full-Stack Wireless Software Engineer, you will contribute to building and validating wireless features across the stack—from access points to controllers and management systems. This is a full development and test role, where you will own features from implementation through validation and automation.

 In this role:

Develop and integrate wireless features across AP, controller, and management layers

Write and maintain software in C/C++ and scripting languages (Python)

Design and execute test plans, and develop automation for feature validation

Analyze logs, packet traces, and system behavior to debug issues

Reproduce issues and validate fixes across system components

Set up and use lab environments for testing wireless scenarios

Collaborate with platform, radio, QA, and cloud teams

Minimum Qualification

MS + 0-2 years or BS + 1-3 years of experience

Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python

Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and Wi-Fi (802.11 basics)

Experience or strong interest in testing, automation, and system validation

Strong debugging and analytical skills

Preferred Qualification

Exposure to wireless controllers or cloud-managed networking systems

Experience with tools like Wireshark 

Familiarity with WPA2/WPA3 security

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
